exact_statement: For finite uniform Boolean G(X,S), H(Y,S) with disjoint private X,Y and a fresh fair selector z, the exact mux entropy is half the two branch entropies plus 4 Inf_z plus R=sum_T rho(a_T,b_T), where a,b are the shared-only Fourier amplitudes and rho is defined in PROOF.md section 1. Matching conditional private means imply R=0. For G=1+A(X)(u(S)-1), H=1+B(Y)(u(S)-1), arbitrary Boolean common phase u and independent point activations of probabilities p,q in {0,1,2^(-r): r>=1}, t=Pr[u=-1], the exact correction is R=rho(1-2pt,1-2qt)+4t(1-t)rho(p,q). Every actual shared or surviving private physical query satisfies |R_parent-E R_child|<=54 Inf_queried(F); selector revelation satisfies |R|<=162 Inf_z(F). Therefore H(F)<=half(H(G)+H(H))+166 Inf_z(F), and FEI-certified complete children with constant C transfer at max(C,166). Every finite adaptive physical stopping tree obeys the terminal-inclusive signed-core entropy ledger in PROOF.md section 6 with coherent rates 54 on pre-selector data and 166 at selector nodes, actual reach probabilities, both inherited cores and full actual terminals. At matching p=q, the first private query has the sharper coherent price 12. No arbitrary-core terminal FEI bound or unrelated-phase collision price is asserted. Earlier A058 v5 scoped statements remain at their original hypotheses and locators.
hypotheses: Finite independent uniform physical coordinate blocks X,Y,S and fresh fair selector z; Boolean sign outputs and entropy in bits.
Matching-mean identity assumes equality of the full conditional private mean functions, not merely overall biases.

Common-phase extension assumes G=1+A(X)(u(S)-1), H=1+B(Y)(u(S)-1), one identical arbitrary Boolean u, and disjoint independent point indicators; reached activation probabilities are 0,1,2^(-r) for positive integer r.
Adaptive trees query actual remaining physical coordinates with true reach weights; both core entropies, signed core decrements and complete stopped terminal entropies remain.
The old v5 theorems retain their distinct original hypotheses; the new R subtracts 4 Inf_z and must not be confused with v5's unsubtracted R.

supersedes.scope: Add the norm-free common-phase transport extension; preserve every earlier scoped result and its original proof source.
